teacherCandidates.sql:
with recursive scope as (
  select uid,name,parent_uid from public.knowledge_points where uid=any($1::text[])
  union select k.uid,k.name,k.parent_uid from public.knowledge_points k join scope s on k.parent_uid=s.uid
) select p.question_id,p.content_version_id,p.quality_level,
    p.solution_status,p.asset_status,p.scoring_status,p.path_dependency_sets,p.dependency_closure
    from kb_v2.question_selection_projection p where p.primary_kp_uids && array(select uid::text from scope) order by p.question_id

labelOnlyContainmentProbe.sql:
with recursive scope as (
  select uid,name,parent_uid from public.knowledge_points where uid=any($1::text[])
  union select k.uid,k.name,k.parent_uid from public.knowledge_points k join scope s on k.parent_uid=s.uid
) select p.question_id,p.question_type,p.choice_type
    from kb_v2.question_student_selection_projection p where p.primary_kp_uids && array(select uid::text from scope)
    and p.primary_kp_uids <@ array(select uid::text from scope)
    and p.supporting_kp_uids <@ array(select uid::text from scope) order by p.question_id

answerProvenance.sql:
select a.source_type,a.review_status,count(*),count(distinct a.question_id) distinct_questions
    from kb_v2.question_answers a join kb_v2.questions q on q.current_content_version_id=a.content_version_id
    where a.question_id=any($1::bigint[]) group by 1,2 order by 1,2

solutionProvenance.sql:
select s.source_type,s.review_status,s.eligible_for_scope,count(*),count(distinct s.question_id) distinct_questions
    from kb_v2.question_solution_paths s join kb_v2.questions q on q.current_content_version_id=s.content_version_id
    where s.question_id=any($1::bigint[]) group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3

partStructure.sql:
select q.id question_id,count(p.id)::int part_count
    from kb_v2.questions q left join kb_v2.question_parts p on p.content_version_id=q.current_content_version_id
    where q.id=any($1::bigint[]) group by q.id order by q.id
